name: Operon V0 Public Benchmark Catalog
description: Public benchmark suite defining evaluation case shapes, assertions, and verification criteria without disclosing private gold oracles.

cases.name: Deterministic Exact Key Matching
cases.description: Resolves patient record across disparate source streams without creating duplicate entity identity.

cases.name: Conflict Detection on Immutable Key
cases.description: Flags conflicting primary key mutations as identity conflicts instead of silent overwrite.

cases.name: Completeness Gate Enforcement
cases.description: Intercepts action proposal when required clinical observation is ungrounded or absent.

cases.name: Consistency Gate Cross-Validation
cases.description: Ensures temporal consistency across bitemporal valid-time and transaction-time.

cases.name: Dry-Run Zero Mutation
cases.description: Verifies that dry-run action preparation causes zero persistent database mutations.

cases.name: Anti-Tamper Proposal Binding
cases.description: Rejects approval when viewed proposal digest differs from prepared digest.
